segmentation: The instance segmentation map isolates parts of the people and a few small spherical objects against an unlabelled black background corresponding to the dirt ground, bags, and blade. In frames 1–4, it segments the camera wearer's crouched legs, arms, and hands at the bottom of the frame (3–5 m from the lens and out of reach, with the right hand resting on the right foot and the left hand holding the ground blade out of arm's reach), a blue sandal entering at the bottom-right edge in frames 3–4 (~3–5 m away), and a second person's hand at the top-left edge in frame 4 (~3–5 m away). The segmentation map highlights the incoming foot at the bottom-right of frame 4 and the top-left hand in frame 4 that blend into the busy ground in RGB, but it is highly unreliable across the sequence. Specifically, it splits the camera wearer's own body into multiple overlapping 'person' instances with hard rectangular mask cutoffs in frame 1, merges the wearer's hand with the adjacent standing person in frame 5, misses most of the balls, bags, and the blade entirely, and misclassifies a few orange plastic balls on the ground (~3–5 m away) as 'orange'.
